ANNOTATE BURST T1a-ann-13L — landmark annotation of Muybridge Animal Locomotion plate 13, lateral row (woman walking; 12 phases of one stride; PUBLIC DOMAIN). task_id "T1a-ann-13L".

You are given 12 reference images (frame_00 … frame_11, printed order = time order, 0.120 s apart). For EACH frame, view_image it and record landmarks in the image's own pixel coordinates (origin top-left, x right, y down; each image is 395 wide × 773 high):
  head_top [x,y] — the topmost point of the head INCLUDING hair; chin [x,y]; hip [x,y] — the greater trochanter (hip joint) on the near side; near_sole [x,y] — the centre of the sole of the leg CLOSER to the camera; far_sole [x,y] — centre of the sole of the farther leg; near_wrist [x,y]; far_wrist [x,y]; ground_y — the y of the ground line under the feet; planted_near (true/false) — is the near foot bearing weight and flat/still on the ground; planted_far (true/false); confidence 0–1 per point (0.3 if occluded/guessed — still give a best estimate, never omit).
Also give, once: subject_height_px = mean over frames of (ground_y − head_top.y), and stride_notes: which frames are the two CONTACT frames (heel strike) and which are PASSING (feet together under the body), in your judgement.
Write out/annotation.json: {"plate":"13","row":"lateral","frames":[{"frame":0,"head_top":[x,y],"chin":[x,y],"hip":[x,y],"near_sole":[x,y],"far_sole":[x,y],"near_wrist":[x,y],"far_wrist":[x,y],"ground_y":y,"planted_near":bool,"planted_far":bool,"confidence":{...}}, …12 entries…],"subject_height_px":…,"stride_notes":{"contact_frames":[…],"passing_frames":[…]}}.
No code. No image generation. No web. No agents. Do not write anything outside out/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1a-ann-13L"): files = out/annotation.json with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming frames where a landmark was hard to place. Never PASS/FAIL.
